records.newest_note: 2026-09-30 intel run: besides /v2/recentvictims, https://api.ransomware.live/v2/recentcyberattacks (press title/summary/link per incident) and /v2/groupvictims/<group> work via `fetch_source.py url`; recentcyberattacks surfaces press-confirmed incidents that recentvictims does not, so it is the better nexus filter.
records.recipe_note: 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → api: python3 tools/fetch_source.py url https://api.ransomware.live/v2/recentvictims  (new victim claims, one record each with victim/group/activity/country/claim_url); /v2/groups for per-group view. AVOID: Do NOT rely on the homepage HTML for automation — use the JSON API. Treat as discovery: every claim is an unverified extortion-site post; corroborate before citing as confirmed breach..

records.newest_note: 2026-09-29: health flag was a false positive (metadata-only JSON envelope under the alnum floor); `sec-edgar 8k` (default Item 1.05, trailing 14 d) is the correct content-check command, verified live: 1 hit in the last 14 d (Astrana Health, 2026-09-23), 17 hits 2026-07-01..2026-09-29. An empty 14-day window is a normal quiet result, not a failure; widen with `sec-edgar 8k <start> <end> 1.05`. (2026-09-29T2134Z-audit)
records.recipe_note: 2026-06-20 full audit (v2.62): live=Y, drill=Y. FETCH → api: `python3 tools/fetch_source.py sec-edgar 8k <startdt> <enddt> 1.05` (returns Item 1.05 hits w/ filing_url) then bridge `url <filing_index>` to find the .htm doc, then bridge `url <doc.htm>` to read the Item 1.05 body. AVOID: The documented efts.sec.gov ...search-index API URL returns metadata only (no doc text) — don't expect the body there. Use the sec-edgar subcommand for discovery, then drill the per-filing .htm. WebFetch on efts JSON is unnecessary..
